    "Compatibility, dimensions, capacity, package quantity, and existing ownership determine whether related products are practically useful.",
    "Fine distinctions in tone, musical style, and complementary function determine which broadly relevant items users would actually choose."

    "The proportion of top-ranked items users would choose now, distinguished from items they merely recognize as related or potentially appealing later.",
    "The frequency of top-ranked rejections attributed to redundancy, unsupported equipment assumptions, incompatible specifications, or excessive quantity.",
    "The frequency of broad-theme matches rejected for missing current mood, style, or task, compared with accepted recommendations supported by specific recent behavior.",

  ]
